Design of a phase III multicenter trial to evaluate the efficacy of the RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine in children across diverse transmission settings in Africa.
No significant efficacy against severe malaria was noted during the study period in young infants or children who did not receive a booster dose of vaccine.
First results of phase 3 trial of RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine in African children.
Efficacy against clinical malaria (primary case definition) of a primary schedule with or without a booster dose and incremental efficacy of the booster dose.
